verdict.rationale: The only evidence resembling event-triggered automation is OCI Budgets, which lets you set spend thresholds that trigger alert notifications — a narrow, single example of rule-based triggering. There's no evidence of a general-purpose events/rules engine (e.g., OCI Events, Notifications, Functions triggers) that lets users define arbitrary event-condition-action rules. Missing for 10: documentation of a dedicated events/rules service, examples of custom trigger conditions, and evidence of broader action types beyond budget alerts.
